description: This file defines the interface IEventHandler for handling container events within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares four pure virtual methods that must be implemented by derived classes to respond to container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state change. The file includes licensing information, include directives, and the namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling container-related events, requiring implementation of methods for container start, stop, failure, and state change notifications.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has started, with related data in a JsonObject.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has stopped, with related data in a JsonObject.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has failed, with related data in a JsonObject.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state changes, with related data in a JsonObject.
